items.title: Lizzie Miles Interview, 1951-01-18
items.q: She was then Nettie Lewis. She was a singer and dancer. Well, and I worked there with him and his wife.

ctx.x: He knew why I know him.

Yeah? And his wife was an entertainer, too. She was then Nettie Lewis. She was a singer and dancer. Well, and I worked there with him and his wife. Then I came back home. I left and I came back to New Orleans. How when was this? Was it after the war? After the war? After the first war. Oh, yes, because the first war was around 1970 to 18, huh?
